Short bio

Glitches & Stitches is an electronic music project that treats unfinished songs as raw material. Fragments, mistakes and happy accidents are pulled out, stitched into new tracks and glitched until they become something new, then reused again, so the catalog grows into one interconnected body of work.

Long bio

Glitches & Stitches is an electronic/EDM project built around a method rather than a single sound. A half-finished song can hold a great drop, a melody, a vocal, a texture or a transition. Instead of being thrown away, those pieces are extracted and stitched into future tracks.

The glitches are the mistakes, artifacts, chopped audio and corrupted sounds; the stitches are what join separate fragments into something cohesive. The music lives in electronic music without being tied to one subgenre: heavy sound design, resampling, chopped repetition and unexpected transitions, with melodic, emotional sections set against chaotic ones. Experimental, but never random.

The project is deliberately recursive. Finished tracks become source material for new ones, and whole songs get stitched together again: remix, then remix². Over time the catalog becomes interconnected, with recurring sounds and fragments that reward listeners who notice where they have appeared before.
